name: Tomato bacterial spot
symptoms: Small dark, water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit.

treatments.guidance: Remove infected leaves and avoid overhead watering; copper-based organic sprays can reduce spread.
treatments.safety_warning: Wear gloves and a mask; follow the product label and the pre-harvest interval.

treatments.guidance: Apply a copper-based bactericide registered for this crop.
treatments.safety_warning: Use only products registered for this crop in the UAE and follow the label dose.

treatments.guidance: Use certified clean seed or seedlings and rotate crops for at least two seasons.
treatments.safety_warning: Disinfect tools between plants.

name: Tomato early blight
symptoms: Brown spots with rings (target pattern) on older leaves.

treatments.guidance: Remove and bag infected leaves; a neem oil or bicarbonate spray every 7 days can slow spread.
treatments.safety_warning: Wear gloves and a mask; follow the product label and the pre-harvest interval.

treatments.guidance: Apply a fungicide registered for this disease on this crop, rotating active ingredients.
treatments.safety_warning: Use only products registered for this crop in the UAE and follow the label dose.

treatments.guidance: Water at the base in the morning, space plants for airflow and avoid working with wet plants.
treatments.safety_warning: Disinfect tools between plants.

name: Tomato mosaic virus
symptoms: Light and dark green mosaic pattern, distorted leaves.

treatments.guidance: There is no cure: remove and destroy infected plants to protect healthy ones.
treatments.safety_warning: Do not compost infected plants.

treatments.guidance: No chemical cures the virus; control the spread by hands and tools with a registered product if needed.
treatments.safety_warning: Use only products registered for this crop in the UAE and follow the label dose.

treatments.guidance: Use resistant varieties, control spread by hands and tools and keep weeds down around the crop.
treatments.safety_warning: Wash hands and tools after handling infected plants.

name: Tomato spider mites
symptoms: Fine yellow speckling on leaves, fine webbing underneath.

treatments.guidance: Spray the underside of leaves with water or insecticidal soap every 5-7 days.
treatments.safety_warning: Wear gloves and a mask; follow the product label and the pre-harvest interval.

treatments.guidance: Apply a miticide registered for tomato, rotating active ingredients.
treatments.safety_warning: Use only products registered for this crop in the UAE and follow the label dose.

treatments.guidance: Avoid drought stress and dust; check the underside of leaves weekly.
treatments.safety_warning: Keep children and animals away from treated plants until dry.
